sloka: एवमुक्त्वा दधिमुखो वनपालान् महाबलः ।जगाम सहसोत्पत्य वनपालैः समन्वितः ।। ५.६२.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā dadhimukho vanapālān mahābalaḥ ।jagāma sahasotpatya vanapālaiḥ samanvitaḥ ।। 5.62.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Powerful Dadhimukha having said that to the guardians of the garden rose up to the sky and went off with them.
